arxiv.title: Using Evidence-Centered Design to Guide Prompt Engineering in Measurement: An Illustration with Automated Essay Scoring
arxiv.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) models, particularly large language models (LLMs), are increasingly used in educational settings for tasks such as item generation, automated scoring, and feedback delivery. The quality of these outputs depends not only on the AI model but also on how users construct the prompts that guide model behaviors. Current prompt engineering practices are largely ad hoc, relying on trial and error rather than principled design. This lack of structure introduces validity threats including construct misrepresentation, construct-irrelevant variance, and limited reproducibility. We propose that Evidence-Centered Design (ECD), a framework in educational measurement for structuring valid inferences from observed performance, can serve as a principled foundation for prompt engineering in educational applications. We map the three core ECD models, the student model, the evidence model, and the task model, onto the components of educational prompt design, and describe a workflow for ECD-based prompt engineering. We derive five design principles from this mapping and present an empirical study contrasting ECD-designed prompts with state-of-the-art (SOTA) prompting baselines on an automated scoring task. Our empirical study demonstrates the usefulness of this framework on automated scoring. Results suggest that treating prompting as assessment design rather than informal instructions strengthens the validity, reliability, and fairness of AI-generated educational outputs.
arxiv.titleZh: 使用证据中心设计指导测量中的提示工程：以自动作文评分为例
arxiv.summaryZh: 生成式 AI 与 LLM 已被用于题目生成、自动评分和反馈，其输出质量不仅取决于模型，也取决于提示如何构造，而当前提示工程多靠试错，缺乏原则，带来构念误表征、构念无关变异与可复现性不足等效度威胁。作者提出以教育测量中的证据中心设计(ECD)作为提示设计的原则性基础，把学生模型、证据模型、任务模型三个核心模型映射到教育提示的组件上，给出基于 ECD 的提示工程工作流并提炼五条设计原则。在自动作文评分任务上与 SOTA 提示基线做实证对比，结果表明把提示视为评估设计而非非正式指令，可提升 AI 生成教育输出的效度、信度与公平性。
arxiv.reason: 教育测量垂直场景的提示工程，与后训练/Agent 主线关联弱

arxiv.title: Words to World: Benchmarking LLMs in Interactive Physical Environments
arxiv.abstract: Words are increasingly becoming an interface for action: large language models (LLMs) can now invoke tools, operate devices, and make decisions that affect the physical world. However, current benchmarks largely evaluate LLMs through static text responses, offline tool calls, or simulated tasks, leaving open the question of how well they can act in real physical environments. We present a benchmark for measuring LLMs in closed-loop physical interaction, where models control a harness system connected to real-world components including robotic arms, cameras, and sensors. In each task, the model must issue instructions, receive physical feedback from the environment, interpret the resulting state, and adapt its next action accordingly. This setting evaluates capabilities beyond language understanding, including grounded perception, action planning, tool selection, spatial reasoning, feedback-driven correction, and robustness to execution uncertainty. Through experiments with representative LLMs, we characterize their ability to translate linguistic reasoning into physical actions and identify common failure modes such as hallucinated state changes, poor recovery from unexpected outcomes, and unstable long-horizon plans. Our benchmark aims to provide a systematic foundation for evaluating LLMs as interactive agents that connect words, tools, and the physical world.
arxiv.titleZh: 从词语到世界：在交互式物理环境中评测 LLM
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有评测多依赖静态文本、离线工具调用或纯仿真任务，无法回答 LLM 能否在真实物理环境中闭环行动。该工作构建了连接真实机械臂、摄像头与传感器的 harness 系统，模型需发出指令、接收物理反馈、解析环境状态并据此调整下一步动作，考察具身感知、动作规划、工具选择、空间推理与反馈纠错等能力。实验刻画了代表性 LLM 把语言推理转化为物理动作的水平，并指出幻觉式状态变化、异常恢复能力差、长程规划不稳定等典型失败模式，为把 LLM 当作连接语言、工具与物理世界的交互式智能体提供评测基础。
arxiv.reason: 评测 LLM 闭环物理交互，属具身机器人方向，仅与 Agent 擦边

arxiv.title: Understanding Unified VLMs: From Attention Probing to Guidance Tuning for Multimodal Generation
arxiv.abstract: Unified vision-language models (VLMs) perform both text-to-image (T2I) and image-to-text (I2T) generation with one shared Transformer backbone, yet how the backbone processes the condition in either direction remains poorly understood. We study this question from the perspective of conditional guidance: we probe every attention head to show the activation difference between two branches of classifier-free guidance (CFG) with different conditional guidance. On two unified VLMs of autoregressive and masked-diffusion paradigms, the probing reveals a subset of heads that are more sensitive to the change of condition while others are agnostic to it. This characteristic pattern holds in both T2I and I2T generation and is largely stable across data samples, demonstrating the internal mechanism of unified VLMs. Motivated by this, we propose a new inference-time intervention approach for unified multimodal generation, named \textit{HeadTuned-CFG}, which uses the probed condition-change awareness to select and tune the conditional guidance at the attention-head level. Experiments show consistent benefits in both multimodal generation directions of unified VLMs without additional training, and in particular substantial improvements over strong baselines in T2I generation. These results further support the key finding of our probing analysis: the observed pattern of functional specialization is an intrinsic property of unified VLMs.
arxiv.titleZh: 理解统一视觉语言模型:从注意力探测到面向多模态生成的引导微调
arxiv.summaryZh: 统一 VLM 用同一 Transformer 主干同时完成 T2I 与 I2T 生成，但主干在两个方向上如何处理条件信息仍不清楚。该工作逐个注意力头探测 CFG 两分支(不同条件引导)的激活差异，在自回归与掩码扩散两类统一 VLM 上发现一部分头对条件变化敏感、另一部分与之无关，且该模式在 T2I 与 I2T 中一致并跨样本稳定。据此提出免训练的推理期干预方法 HeadTuned-CFG，在注意力头粒度上选择并调整条件引导，两个生成方向均有稳定收益，T2I 相对强基线提升明显。
arxiv.reason: 统一 VLM 注意力探测有趣，但落点是图像生成，偏离关注方向

arxiv.title: Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of LLMs in Learnable Low-Rank Subspaces
arxiv.abstract: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs). However, ZO optimization suffers from high variance in high-dimensional parameter spaces. While recent methods restrict perturbations to random low-rank subspaces, these subspaces often misalign with task-specific descent directions. We propose AdaSub-ZO, a novel forward-only fine-tuning framework in learnable low-rank subspaces. Instead of relying on fixed random matrices, AdaSub-ZO iteratively learns layer-wise projection matrices directly from finite-difference feedback to track task-aware descent directions. Furthermore, AdaSub-ZO incorporates a subspace momentum acceleration mechanism to smooth noisy gradient estimates across evolving subspace bases. Extensive experiments on natural language understanding tasks demonstrate that AdaSub-ZO outperforms existing ZO baselines, substantially reducing gradient estimation variance and accelerating convergence.
arxiv.comment: 7 pages, 4 figures
arxiv.titleZh: 在可学习低秩子空间中对 LLM 进行零阶微调
arxiv.summaryZh: 零阶优化可实现大模型显存高效的微调，但高维参数空间中的扰动方差过大；已有方法把扰动限制在随机低秩子空间，而这些子空间常与任务相关的下降方向错位。AdaSub-ZO 不再依赖固定随机矩阵，而是利用有限差分反馈逐层迭代学习投影矩阵，以跟踪任务感知的下降方向，并引入子空间动量加速机制来平滑子空间基演化过程中的噪声梯度估计。在自然语言理解任务上，该方法优于现有零阶基线，显著降低梯度估计方差并加快收敛。
arxiv.reason: 零阶微调新方法，命中高效训练与显存受限微调方向

arxiv.title: HarnessNet: Feedback-driven Hierarchical Joint Harness Evolution for Multi-agent Systems
arxiv.abstract: AI agents can evolve by using environment feedback to revise their harnesses, the software managing model inputs, tool use, memory, and execution, while keeping foundation models frozen. Existing studies focus on single agents, leaving joint harness evolution in multi-agent systems (MAS) underexplored. A single global optimizer faces growing context and workload as the system scales, while access restrictions may prevent sharing agent internals or system-wide feedback. We propose HarnessNet, a framework for hierarchical harness evolution in MAS. Its basic unit, Agentron, comprises an evolvable forward harness, a foundation model, and a local optimizer that can observe and modify only that harness. Agentrons form a layered graph through which environment feedback propagates backward, with upstream optimizers receiving node-specific feedback from the downstream layer. This decomposes joint harness evolution into smaller, coordinated tasks with separate contexts, reducing individual optimizers' context and workload while keeping access local. Optimizers need not access all agent trajectories or raw environment feedback. Experiments on AgentBench with multiple foundation models demonstrate the feasibility of training HarnessNet. Compared with a single global optimizer, HarnessNet achieves comparable performance gains while respecting local privacy and requiring fewer tokens and less time per optimizer call. A migration study shows that the evolved harnesses remain jointly effective after replacing the foundation models, suggesting transferability across models.
arxiv.comment: A novel method for multi-agent system harness joint evolution
arxiv.titleZh: HarnessNet:面向多智能体系统的反馈驱动分层联合 Harness 演化
arxiv.summaryZh: 多智能体系统中 harness(管理模型输入、工具调用、记忆与执行的软件层)的联合演化尚缺研究，而单一全局优化器随系统规模扩大上下文与负载持续膨胀，访问限制也使其难以共享智能体内部信息与全局反馈。HarnessNet 以 Agentron 为基本单元，每个单元包含可演化的 forward harness、冻结的基础模型和只能观测与修改本 harness 的局部优化器，Agentron 构成分层图并使环境反馈逐层回传，上游优化器仅接收下层节点的特定反馈，从而把联合演化拆解为上下文隔离的小规模协同任务。在 AgentBench 上的多基础模型实验表明该框架可训练，相比单一全局优化器取得相当的性能增益，同时每次优化器调用消耗更少 token 与时间并保持本地访问限制;迁移实验显示替换基础模型后演化出的 harness 仍保持联合有效，具备跨模型可迁移性。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体 harness 联合演化，直击 Agent 自进化与 harness 方向

arxiv.title: Running Fewer Loops Removes Refusal Behaviour in Recurrent-Depth Language Models
arxiv.abstract: A recurrent-depth language model reuses one block of weights several times in a row. The number of repetitions, which we call loops, is chosen when the model runs, not when it is trained, and running fewer is cheaper and faster, so a deployment may choose to do it. Running fewer loops also makes these models less safe, and the loss of safety is larger than the loss of anything else we measured. We study four released Ouro checkpoints and Huginn-0125. At half of its trained depth, Ouro-1.4B-Thinking still solves 0.692 of the GSM8K maths problems, against 0.775 at full depth, keeping 89% of its accuracy. Over the same reduction, the rate at which it helps with harmful requests rises from 0.038 to 0.205, 5.3 times higher. The information is not lost: a linear classifier reads whether a request is harmful from the model's internal state after a single loop, with an ROC AUC of 0.967 against 0.986 at full depth. What the missing loops remove is the refusal that should follow. We measure the effect with four instruments, one generating no text at all, and reproduce it on a second model family. Removing a single direction from Ouro-1.4B's internal state at full depth drops its refusal rate on harmful prompts from 0.950 to 0.130, identifying what the shallow model is missing. Two run-time repairs do not help: the models' early-exit rules do not spend more loops on harmful requests, and choosing a depth per request does not recover the loss. Changing the training does. Standard safety training makes the shallow model safe only by refusing 0.865 of harmless requests, while training at randomly chosen depths reaches a separation of +0.399 between harmful and harmless refusal at one loop, against +0.118. On Huginn-0125 it keeps harmful help at or below 0.040 at every depth from 1 to 32 loops, where standard training reaches 0.194, and it costs no accuracy at full depth.
arxiv.titleZh: 减少循环次数会消除循环深度语言模型中的拒绝行为
arxiv.summaryZh: 循环深度语言模型推理时复用同一权重块，循环数可在运行时调整，减少循环更省算力却显著削弱安全对齐。四个 Ouro checkpoint 与 Huginn-0125 上测得:Ouro-1.4B-Thinking 半深度 GSM8K 仍有 0.692(全深度 0.775)，协助有害请求的比例却从 0.038 升至 0.205;其单循环内部状态仍能以 0.967 的 ROC AUC 线性判读请求是否有害，丢失的是后续拒绝。全深度移除单一方向可将拒绝率从 0.950 降到 0.130;早退等运行时修补无效，在随机深度上训练则把单循环的有害/无害拒绝分离度从 +0.118 提到 +0.399。
arxiv.reason: 循环深度架构的推理时深度与安全对齐，命中架构与后训练方向

arxiv.title: PANINI-DR: Controlled Deep Research through Generative Semantic Workspaces
arxiv.abstract: Deep research requires connecting multiple steps of search, reasoning, and computation, with intermediate findings guiding what to investigate next. As investigations grow, agents must maintain research state across model calls and check findings before errors propagate into subsequent work. We introduce PANINI-DR, a multi-agent harness that separates coordination of the overall investigation from the research and verification of individual subquestions. A shared workspace, built on the Generative Semantic Workspace representation, records subquestions, their dependencies, findings, and supporting evidence. Researchers investigate individual subquestions, while a separate verification agent checks proposed answers against those subquestions and their evidence. Verification feedback guides further investigation, and recorded findings inform subsequent assignments. We evaluate PANINI-DR on BrowseComp-Plus, FRAMES, and MoNaCo against seven state-of-the-art deep-research harnesses, all using a shared language-model backbone and frozen corpora. PANINI-DR achieves the strongest average performance across the three benchmarks. On BrowseComp-Plus, it achieves 73.3% accuracy, outperforming the next-best harness by 16.0 points. Its advantage is strongest on hard questions, where it answers nearly twice as many as the next-best harness. Ablations further show that structured planning and persistent state improve performance, as does checking each finding against its cited evidence before it is reused. Because a model can answer correctly from memory alone, we also analyze the evidence retained by each harness. PANINI-DR achieves the highest answer recoverability from saved evidence on all three benchmarks, while complementary claim-support audits show stronger evidence-backed answers. Accounting for this evidence changes how harnesses compare and further strengthens PANINI-DR's advantage.
arxiv.comment: Under review at ICLR 2027. 37 pages, 1 figure, 22 tables. M. Yigit Turali and Shreyas Rajesh contributed equally
arxiv.titleZh: PANINI-DR:通过生成式语义工作空间实现可控深度研究
arxiv.summaryZh: 深度研究需要串联搜索、推理与计算，并在多次模型调用间保持研究状态、在错误扩散前校验中间发现。PANINI-DR是多智能体harness，将整体调查协调与子问题研究、验证分离:基于Generative Semantic Workspace的共享工作区记录子问题、依赖、发现与证据，独立验证智能体依据子问题及其证据审查答案，反馈驱动后续调查。在BrowseComp-Plus、FRAMES、MoNaCo上，与七个SOTA深度研究harness在共享模型与冻结语料下对比，平均表现最佳，BrowseComp-Plus达73.3%，领先次优16.0分，难题答题量近次优两倍;消融显示结构化规划、持久状态与逐条证据校验均有增益。

arxiv.title: Exploring Jailbreak Vulnerability Across Depth-Based Dynamic Inference in Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been shown to be computationally expensive and vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, in which adversarial prompts bypass safety alignment and induce harmful responses. To address this inefficiency, a range of techniques have been proposed to enable efficient LLM inference. Depth-based dynamic inference has demonstrated promising results by enabling outputs to be generated from intermediate layers. It offers the flexibility to adjust model behavior based on the available resource budget. However, how this flexibility affects the robustness of LLMs against jailbreak attacks remains unexplored. In this paper, we address this gap via a comprehensive investigation into the impact of depth-based dynamic inference on the robustness of LLMs against jailbreak attacks. Specifically, we make the following key observations: 1) Shallow exits are consistently more robust to jailbreak attacks than deeper ones; 2) Exit depth affects how easily the adversarial suffix can be optimized, with deeper exits reaching lower attack loss; and 3) Adversarial suffixes affect utility uniformly across exit depths. These insights can help design dynamic inference methodologies that are more robust to jailbreak attacks. Code is available at https://github.com/LassNajmuldeen/balcony-jailbreaking
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of Language Model Security (FLMSec). 10 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables
arxiv.titleZh: 探索大语言模型中基于深度的动态推理下的越狱脆弱性
arxiv.summaryZh: 基于深度的动态推理(如早退)能让 LLM 从中间层输出以节省算力并适配资源预算，但这种灵活性对越狱攻击鲁棒性的影响此前未被研究。该工作系统考察了不同退出深度下的越狱表现，发现三个规律:浅层退出始终比深层退出更抗越狱;退出深度会影响对抗后缀的优化难度，深层退出可达到更低的攻击损失;对抗后缀对各退出深度的任务效用影响则基本一致。结论可为设计同时兼顾效率与安全对齐的动态推理方法提供参考。
arxiv.reason: 越狱鲁棒性与高效推理交叉，但属 workshop 观察性研究，分量有限

arxiv.title: SocraticRepair: Planning-Guided Socratic Tutoring for Program Debugging and Misconception Repair
arxiv.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in computer science education. However, the teaching abilities of even the most powerful LLMs are limited: they tend to reveal the solution prematurely and may lose focus on the learner's current debugging objective. To address this, we introduce SocraticRepair, a planning-guided Socratic tutoring framework for program debugging and miscon- ception repair that adapts prior planning-guided tutoring work (Li et al., 2026b). The framework is instantiated in the Python programming domain by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct on synthetic multi-turn tutoring dialogues constructed from four preprocessed programming datasets. The system is evaluated using a predefined set of independent metrics and benchmarked against a general-purpose LLM. The experiments show that SocraticRepair achieves higher scores on stepwise scaffolding and question quality while also substantially reducing premature solution disclosure. The results also identify reliable pedagogical plan generation as an important remaining challenge.
arxiv.titleZh: SocraticRepair:规划引导的苏格拉底式辅导，用于程序调试与迷思概念修复
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 在计算机教育中倾向过早给出答案、偏离学习者当前调试目标的问题，提出规划引导的苏格拉底式辅导框架 SocraticRepair:基于四个预处理编程数据集合成多轮辅导对话，在 Python 域微调 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct。用一组独立指标与通用 LLM 对比评测，结果显示其在渐进式支架与提问质量上得分更高，并显著减少答案的过早泄露。可靠的教学计划生成仍是待解难点，适用于编程教学辅导场景。
arxiv.reason: 教育垂直应用，仅与 LLM 微调擦边，相关性有限

arxiv.title: Do LLMs differentiate linguistic traits internally?: A layer-wise analysis
arxiv.abstract: Large language models often produce judgments that resemble human responses, but it remains unclear whether they internally capture linguistic nuances such as conventional versus idiomatic meaning. A layer-wise representational analysis was conducted on two equal-sized pre-trained models, Llama-3.2-1B and Gemma-3-1B-PT, to examine whether and where these models differentiate linguistic traits from input. The analysis combined layer-wise probing with geometric distance measures, using the top embedding dimensions ranked by principal component loadings for each layer. The results show that even with equal capacity, models organize linguistic information in fundamentally different ways, suggesting the need to analyze internal representational geometry, examining not just behavioral outputs but semantic space alignment when evaluating how closely human and model language interpretation correspond.
arxiv.comment: & pages, 6 figures, 2 tables
arxiv.titleZh: LLM 内部是否区分语言特征?:一项逐层分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 输出虽近似人类判断、但内部是否真正编码惯用义与字面义等语言细微差别仍不清楚的问题，对 Llama-3.2-1B 与 Gemma-3-1B-PT 两个参数量相同的预训练模型做逐层表征分析:结合逐层探针与几何距离度量，并按主成分载荷为每层筛选 top 嵌入维度。结果显示，即使容量相同，两个模型组织语言信息的方式也根本不同。作者据此主张，评估人机语言理解的一致性时，除行为输出外还需考察内部表征几何与语义空间对齐。
arxiv.reason: LLM 表征逐层探针分析，偏可解释性，与关注方向擦边

arxiv.title: Continuous Risk-Based Scheduling for Food Safety Inspection: Integrating Historical Decay with Event-Driven Consumer Review Signals
arxiv.abstract: Batch risk-based inspection scheduling struggles to detect a critical failure class: food facilities with recent clean inspections that subsequently develop severe violations. Traditional systems recompute risk on fixed planning cycles using static historical data, leaving blind spots between inspection cycles. To address this, we introduce the Continuous Inspection Risk (CIR) system, an event-driven scheduling pipeline that re-ranks the inspection queue dynamically as new data arrives. CIR combines a decay-weighted historical score with a stream of real-time consumer reviews triaged by a language-model classifier. A key structural contribution is our temporal partition rule, which strictly excludes reviews predating the most recent inspection to prevent superseded signals from skewing current risk. Evaluating CIR on 9,505 routine inspections in Santa Clara County, California (2024-2026), we show that history-based scoring alone reduces mean time-to-detection of major violations by 69 days (20.9%) under a 30% inspection budget, but fails to anticipate severe vermin-related closures (0/8 detected). Incorporating post-inspection review signals drastically improves performance, predicting 7 of 8 vermin closures with an average lead time of 117 days-firing on the exact day of review publication in four instances. Introducing a review corroboration rule improves precision from 0.70 to 0.78 without loss of recall. Finally, we analyze critical implementation challenges, documenting a data-hygiene pitfall (stale review leakage across inspection boundaries) and an evaluation limitation involving unobserved facility self-remediation. This work provides the first case-level evaluation of event-driven inspection triggering using open data and provides a reproducible benchmark for review-augmented public health systems
arxiv.titleZh: 面向食品安全检查的连续风险调度：融合历史衰减与事件驱动的消费者评论信号
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对固定周期重算风险、导致近期检查合格却随后严重违规的设施被漏检，提出事件驱动的连续检查风险(CIR)系统:随新数据到达动态重排检查队列，融合衰减加权历史评分与语言模型分类器筛选的实时消费者评论，并用时间分区规则排除最近一次检查之前的评论，避免过时信号污染风险。在加州圣克拉拉县 9505 次常规检查(2024–2026)上，仅用历史评分在 30% 预算下把重大违规平均发现时间缩短 69 天(20.9%)，却漏掉全部 8 起严重虫害停业;叠加检查后评论信号可预测其中 7 起，评论佐证规则把精确率从 0.70 提至 0.78。
arxiv.reason: LLM 仅作评论分类器，主体是食品安全垂直应用

arxiv.title: SAFE-KV: Causal Suffix Repair for Behavior-Preserving Non-Prefix KV Cache Reuse in RAG
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) reuses the same documents across many requests, making non-prefix KV-cache reuse attractive. Yet a cached document state is not reusable text: it is a context-conditioned causal state whose keys and values depend on the prefix, position, and preceding documents under which it was computed. We formulate non-prefix KV reuse as a behavior-preservation problem with full prefill on the exact prompt as the reference, and introduce SAFE-KV, which repairs a composed cache by re-encoding the causal suffix from a selected start document. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, prefix-conditioned composition preserves only 47.2% of HotpotQA-500 and 37.8% of 2Wiki-500 full-prefill answers; SAFE-KV with risk-guided K2 selection restores 99.8%/98.4% (donor-copy protocol) and 100.0%/98.4% with actual suffix forwarding. Document-only and fixed-window repairs recover far less, because the document states after the repaired region keep histories that omit it. Reuse without repair is exact up to four documents and degrades at sixteen, where suffix repair recovers 98-100%. Faithful repair re-encodes most of the context, so in a single-request L40S study SAFE-KV's operating rule serves every workload by full prefill. SAFE-KV thus establishes the causal-state contract for non-prefix reuse and a validated repair mechanism that meets it.

arxiv.titleZh: SAFE-KV:面向 RAG 中保持行为一致的非前缀 KV 缓存复用的因果后缀修复
arxiv.summaryZh: RAG 中同一文档被反复检索，非前缀 KV 缓存复用颇具吸引力，但缓存状态是依赖前缀与位置的因果状态，并非可复用文本。SAFE-KV 把非前缀复用形式化为以完整 prefill 为参照的行为保持问题，通过从选定起始文档重新编码因果后缀来修复拼接缓存。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上，前缀条件拼接仅保留 HotpotQA-500 的 47.2% 与 2Wiki-500 的 37.8% 全前缀答案，SAFE-KV 配合风险引导的 K2 选择恢复到 99.8%/98.4%(donor-copy 协议)与 100.0%/98.4%(真实后缀前向)。由于忠实修复需重编码大部分上下文，L40S 实验显示该操作规则对每个负载都退回完整 prefill。
arxiv.reason: KV 缓存复用与 RAG 推理效率，问题形式化清晰、实验系统

arxiv.title: DeltaNet-PC: Test-Time Memory Without Backpropagation Through Time
arxiv.abstract: Test-time memorization of sequential information is a foundational capability for any intelligent system that needs to rapidly store and retrieve data, as demonstrated by the attention mechanism in large language models. However, Transformers and linear attention variants are trained via backpropagation through time (BPTT), which has drawbacks such as its enormous memory requirements. Predictive coding (PC), an algorithm that optimizes a prediction-error energy function with local updates, offers a compelling solution but still lacks test-time memory for sequential data. We develop a solution to this problem by treating the per-step memory update $ΔS_t$ as a latent variable, as opposed to a slow weight to be learned. By taking the log probability of a standard PC-based probabilistic model, we derive a PC-native solution for verbatim sequence memory, and relate our update rule to common choices in the linear attention literature (e.g., DeltaNet). We present an extensive set of empirical tests to probe our system's properties, including its scaling capacity, memory footprint, and ability to infer a context from evidence (e.g., bank (river) vs. bank (money)). We show how DeltaNet-PC can be used for storing single sequences of data, multiple sequences of data, and key-value associative memory pairs with perfect recall accuracy.
arxiv.titleZh: DeltaNet-PC:无需沿时间反向传播的测试时记忆
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对序列数据的测试时记忆问题:Transformer 与线性注意力变体依赖 BPTT 训练，显存开销巨大;预测编码(PC)以局部更新优化预测误差能量，却缺少逐 token 的测试时记忆。该工作把每步记忆更新 ΔS_t 当作隐变量而非待学的慢权重，由标准 PC 概率模型的对数概率推导出 PC 原生的逐字序列记忆更新规则，并给出其与 DeltaNet 等线性注意力常见更新形式的关系。实验考察了容量扩展、显存占用以及从证据推断上下文(如 bank 指河岸还是银行)的能力，并在单序列、多序列与键值联想记忆任务上实现完全回忆。
arxiv.reason: 线性注意力与测试时记忆机制，命中架构与效率方向

arxiv.title: Game-Theoretic Reinforcement Learning based Topology-Agnostic Defense for Virtual Power Plants
arxiv.abstract: The rapid proliferation of distributed energy resources (DERs) aggregated by virtual power plants (VPPs) elevates cybersecurity risk by expanding the attack surface. A coordinated cyberattack has the potential to disrupt distribution-system, bulk-system, and market operations. Existing cyberphysical defense strategies largely assume access to grid network models and operating conditions, which may not be available to third-party aggregators. This paper proposes a novel hybrid, perturbation-based cyber-physical defense for VPP-operated DERs that blends game-theoretic planning with model-free reinforcement learning (RL) under a Bayesian belief-update framework. Topology agnosticism is defined from the VPP information and implementation perspective: the VPP does not require access to the feeder topology, line parameters, switching configuration, or full system state. This work advances the state of the art through three contributions: (1) a multi-output Gaussian process with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for discrete attacker-type inference, probability of detection, and confidence of detection for modeling the belief distribution; (2) moment-matched Gaussian propagation of posterior beliefs across episodes; and (3) an RL policy that adaptively integrates Stackelberg leader (VPP) actions with exploration. Furthermore, we establish equilibrium existence and derive an episode-level closed-loop utility bound connecting attacker-belief uncertainty with GT-RL action alignment. Evaluations on IEEE 13- and 123-Bus feeders with DER portfolios demonstrate effective detection under attacker-model uncertainty and evaluated feeder re-configuration conditions, while requiring no explicit feeder-topology knowledge. Overall, the results indicate that combining bi-level game-theoretic planning, nonparametric Bayesian inference, and adaptive RL is a promising direction for VPP cybersecurity.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向虚拟电厂的基于博弈论强化学习的拓扑无关防御
arxiv.summaryZh: 虚拟电厂聚合的分布式能源扩大了攻击面，而现有网络物理防御普遍依赖电网模型与运行状态，第三方聚合商难以获取。该工作提出一种扰动式混合防御:用多输出高斯过程配合 Hamiltonian Monte Carlo 推断攻击者类型、检测概率与置信度，通过矩匹配高斯传播在回合间更新贝叶斯信念，并用强化学习策略把 Stackelberg 领导者动作与探索自适应结合，从而在不需要馈线拓扑、线路参数与完整系统状态的前提下工作。作者还给出均衡存在性证明与回合级闭环效用上界，并在 IEEE 13 与 123 节点馈线上验证了攻击者模型不确定与馈线重构条件下的检测效果。
arxiv.reason: 能源电力垂直领域的网络防御，与 LLM 方向无交集

arxiv.title: UDHRBench: Benchmarking Human Rights in Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in contexts requiring adherence to ethical and legal norms, yet their alignment with internationally recognized human rights standards remains underexplored. We introduce UDHRBench, a large-scale benchmark for operationalising the evaluation of large language model compliance with the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. The dataset comprises 1,124 human rights confronting questions covering all 30 articles and 4,496 responses from four large language models (ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, and Fanar), manually annotated by experts for alignment, with high inter-annotator agreement ($κ= 0.801$). Our analysis reveals systematic and non-trivial misalignments, showing that violations typically arise through seemingly rational reasoning: appeals to efficiency, risk management, or scientific neutrality, rather than explicit rejection of rights. We further propose an LLM-as-a-Judge framework for automated evaluation using zero-shot and few-shot prompting, achieving 89.8\% weighted F1-score in detecting human-rights misalignment, alongside a novel Alignment Leniency Score that quantifies how judge models resolve ambiguous cases. The dataset, annotations, and code will be released as open-source resources (https://sina.birzeit.edu/UDHRBench).
arxiv.comment: Alak Raad and Noreldin Morssy contributed equally to this work
arxiv.titleZh: UDHRBench:面向大语言模型人权合规的基准评测
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对大模型对齐国际公认人权标准的情况缺乏系统评估，构建 UDHRBench:覆盖《世界人权宣言》全部30条条款的1,124道人权质询问题，以及 ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini、Fanar 四个模型的4,496条回复，由专家人工标注(κ=0.801)。分析显示违规多来自「效率」「风险管理」「科学中立」等看似合理的推理，而非对权利的显式否定。进一步提出 LLM-as-a-Judge 自动评估框架，零样本与少样本下检测人权失配的加权 F1 达89.8%，并用 Alignment Leniency Score 量化裁判模型在模糊案例上的倾向。
arxiv.reason: 评测与方法学方向，LLM-as-judge 有新意，但属垂直领域基准

arxiv.title: Only What You've Signed up For: Secure Workflows with Constrained Diffusion Agents
arxiv.abstract: As agentic AI systems take on increasingly complex and consequential tasks, securing them against prompt injection becomes critical. Existing defenses often rely on detecting or reasoning about injected malicious instructions and can therefore remain vulnerable to adaptive attacks that optimize the injection itself. Diffusion language models (dLLMs), an emerging framework for language generation, offer a new opportunity for security enforcement: by iteratively refining their sequence wide predictions, they enable broader-scope constraint enforcement throughout generation. This paper introduces Policy-Constrained Diffusion Agents (CoDA), a framework that enforces task dependent security policies directly within the denoising process of diffusion language models. At each denoising step, CoDA projects token distributions onto a policy-compliant set, maintaining constraint satisfaction throughout generation. We evaluate CoDA across state-of-the-art diffusion language model families under both static and adaptive prompt-injection attacks. Results demonstrate substantial reductions in attack success rate with competitive task utility and practical inference overhead.
arxiv.titleZh: 只做你签约范围内的事:受约束扩散智能体的安全工作流
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 agentic AI 面临的提示注入攻击，现有防御依赖检测或推理恶意指令，面对自适应攻击仍会失效。CoDA 把与任务相关的安全策略直接嵌入扩散语言模型的去噪过程，每个去噪步将 token 分布投影到策略合规集合上，使约束在整段生成中持续满足。在多个主流扩散语言模型上，静态与自适应提示注入的攻击成功率大幅下降，任务效用保持竞争力，推理开销可控。该思路为 Agent 工作流的生成期安全约束提供了一种新路径。
arxiv.reason: Agent 安全防御擦边，但方法基于扩散语言模型，属低分方向

arxiv.title: LexiCan: Lexicographic Canonicalization of Point Clouds for Machine Learning Applications
arxiv.abstract: Canonicalization resolves the rotational and permutation ambiguity of 3D point clouds by selecting a unique orbit representative, maintaining their geometric information while allowing standard architectures, such as Transformers, to operate on them. Existing canonicalizations, however, exhibit discontinuity jumps on molecular configurations and non-trivial invariance errors in popular molecular datasets, which lead to ambiguity in their representation. To bridge this gap, we introduce LexiCan, a canonicalization that is provably invariant under either $O(3)$ or $SO(3)$, empirically invariant to rotations to within $\sim 10^{-6}$ angstroms on the QM9 and QM-sym molecular datasets, and mitigates discontinuity jumps on QM-sym, while running orders of magnitude faster than an existing canonicalization. Finally, non-invariant models perform better on QM9 property prediction and ModelNet40 shape classification with LexiCan than with that canonicalization.
arxiv.titleZh: LexiCan:面向机器学习应用的点云字典序规范化
arxiv.summaryZh: 点云在旋转与置换下存在表示歧义，规范化通过挑选唯一的轨道代表元消除歧义，使 Transformer 等标准架构可直接处理并保留几何信息。现有规范化方法在分子构型上会出现不连续跳变，在常用分子数据集上存在明显的等变性误差。LexiCan 以字典序准则构造规范化，可证明在 O(3) 与 SO(3) 下不变，在 QM9、QM-sym 上对旋转的经验不变性误差约 10⁻⁶ 埃，缓解了 QM-sym 上的不连续跳变，运行速度比现有方法快若干数量级。在 QM9 性质预测与 ModelNet40 形状分类上，非不变模型配合 LexiCan 的精度优于原规范化方法。
arxiv.reason: 3D 点云规范化与分子数据集，不在 LLM 关注方向

arxiv.title: Active Learning for Finding a Needle in a Haystack
arxiv.abstract: Training a classifier to find a rare class of documents, such as hate speech directed at a particular religious group, requires labelled examples that are expensive to obtain when the class makes up only a small fraction of a corpus. Active learning reduces this cost, but it must start from an initial labelled set that contains examples of the target class. Random sampling cannot supply these at reasonable cost, so they must be selected in some other way, such as keyword search, and any such selection biases the initial set towards part of the target class. We evaluate whether active learning can correct this bias. On AG News and Measuring Hate Speech, at a prevalence of around 1%, we compare random sampling with eight active learning strategies, starting from initial sets that cover or omit known subgroups of the target class, and measure recall on the omitted subgroups as well as F1. On AG News, almost every strategy recovers the omitted subgroup. On Measuring Hate Speech, uncertainty-based strategies recover less of the omitted subgroups than random sampling, whereas discriminative active learning recovers 55% of them without a significant loss of F1. Aggregate metrics conceal these differences.
arxiv.titleZh: 大海捞针场景下的主动学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 稀有类别分类器的训练依赖昂贵标注，而这类样本在语料中占比极低;主动学习虽能降低标注成本，却要求初始标注集已含目标类样本，只能靠关键词搜索等手段获得，从而把初始集偏向目标类的某个子群。研究在 AG News 与 Measuring Hate Speech 上以约 1% 的类别占比，对比随机采样与八种主动学习策略，初始集分别覆盖或遗漏目标类的已知子群，并单独统计被遗漏子群的召回与 F1。结果显示 AG News 上几乎所有策略都能找回被遗漏子群;Measuring Hate Speech 上基于不确定性的策略反而不如随机采样，判别式主动学习可恢复 55% 的被遗漏子群且 F1 无明显下降。聚合指标掩盖了这些子群层面的差异。
arxiv.reason: 稀有类别主动学习与标注偏差评估，属方法学擦边，分量有限

arxiv.title: Sanzaru: Benchmarking Protocol Formation under Epistemic & Communication Asymmetry
arxiv.abstract: A language model's ability to solve a task individually does not ensure that a team can solve it under unequal access to information and communication. SANZARU examines this gap through cooperative bomb-defusal puzzles adapted from BOMBANANA! (Lefto Studio, 2026). Task information and action authority are divided among three agents: one cannot hear, another cannot speak, and the third cannot see. The benchmark contains 120 puzzle instances across seven families, each targeting a distinct coordination ability. Across 1512 episodes, 7 models achieve an overall success rate of 49%, ranging from 20% to 86% under the evaluated configurations. Teams develop or adopt diverse communication protocols, from simple gesture codes to Morse and encodings of entire manuals. Yet trace analysis attributes about 60% of 771 team losses to communication, and agents attempt to use channels unavailable to their teammates despite explicit role instructions. Together, task outcomes and interaction traces enable evaluation of both collaborative performance and perspective taking throughout cooperation. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/markli404/sanzaru-benchmark.
arxiv.titleZh: Sanzaru:在认知与通信不对称下的协议形成基准测试
arxiv.summaryZh: 单个模型能独立解出的任务，在信息与通信权限不对等的团队里未必能完成。SANZARU 把这一落差做成基准:合作拆弹谜题中三名智能体分别被剥夺听觉、语言与视觉，任务信息与操作权限被切分，共 120 道题分属七类协调能力。1512 局实验里七个模型的总体成功率为 49%(配置间 20% 到 86%)，团队自发形成手势码、摩尔斯码等通信协议，但轨迹分析把 771 次失败中的约 60% 归因于通信，智能体还常无视角色说明去使用队友不可用的信道。任务结果与轨迹结合，使协作表现与视角采择可同时评估。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体协作与自建通信协议基准，命中 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: Beyond Adjacent Layers: Graph-Guided Layer Fusion for Compressing Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Existing depth-compression methods for large language models (LLMs) score layers individually or group only adjacent or contiguous layers, implicitly assuming that functional redundancy is local. We test this assumption by computing full pairwise Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) similarity matrices for thirteen LLMs from six architecture families (1.6B-14B parameters). Non-adjacent layers have 3.6-15.9x more high-similarity pairs than adjacent ones, a structure that prior similarity-based layer merging has not systematically exploited. We propose Fusion via Community Mining (FCM), which builds the full L x L similarity graph, uses spectral community detection to find clusters of functionally equivalent layers, keeps the highest-Block-Influence layer in each cluster, and applies LoRA recovery; a pre-specified rule computed only on calibration data chooses between cosine and CKA similarity. At 2x compression, FCM lowers mean perplexity below ShortGPT on twelve of thirteen models, significantly on ten (Welch's t-test with Holm-Bonferroni correction; up to 50% on Qwen3-4B), with Mistral-7B the only loss (+13.4%). Against FlattenGPT, SWM, and DeltaLLM under matched calibration and recovery, FCM gives the best perplexity on ten of thirteen models (mean rank 1.15), and it also outperforms MKA on three anchor models. FCM matches or exceeds ShortGPT on 15 of 20 zero-shot reasoning cells and also improves MMLU, LAMBADA, HumanEval pass@1, and free-form generation quality. The 2x-compressed Qwen2.5-7B has 46% fewer parameters, 42% lower peak VRAM, and 84% higher decode throughput on a single A100. Spectral grouping outperforms Fisher contiguous segmentation by 41% and uniform partitioning by 51%, and FCM's advantage grows beyond a 2x crossover up to 3x and persists at the 14B scale. Code: https://github.com/Usama1002/fcm-layer-fusion
arxiv.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/Usama1002/fcm-layer-fusion
arxiv.titleZh: 超越相邻层：图引导的层融合用于压缩大语言模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 LLM 深度压缩方法多对单层打分，或仅合并相邻连续层，隐含假设功能冗余是局部的。该工作对六个架构家族、13 个模型（1.6B–14B）计算全对 CKA 相似度矩阵，发现非相邻层的高相似层对数比相邻层多 3.6–15.9 倍，据此提出 FCM：构建 L×L 相似度图，用谱社区检测找出功能等价的层簇，每簇只保留 Block-Influence 最高的层，再用 LoRA 恢复，并由校准数据上的预设规则在 cosine 与 CKA 之间选择。2× 压缩下，FCM 在 13 个模型中的 12 个上困惑度低于 ShortGPT（10 个显著，Qwen3-4B 最高降 50%），压缩后的 Qwen2.5-7B 参数减少 46%、峰值显存降低 42%、单卡 A100 解码吞吐提升 84%。
arxiv.reason: 层融合深度压缩，效率方向扎实，实验覆盖面广

arxiv.title: Learning Proposition-Level Links from Sentence-Level Supervision for Neuro-Symbolic NLI
arxiv.abstract: We study neuro-symbolic natural language inference (NLI) with independently translated propositional representations of the premise and hypothesis. Before symbolic reasoning, the system must infer semantic links between their proposition-level units (atoms). Existing systems based on Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) and Boolean satisfiability (SAT) identify these links using fixed embedding-based source selection and pretrained sentence-level NLI models not trained for atom-level linking. We introduce a trainable atom linker that jointly predicts link existence, source selection, and relation type. Without atom-pair training annotations, we treat cross-formula link structures as latent and train the linker from sentence-level NLI labels, keeping the translator and SAT reasoner fixed. We evaluate on the full public test splits of Stanford Natural Language Inference (SNLI) and Sentences Involving Compositional Knowledge (SICK), and the matched and mismatched validation splits of Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference (MNLI). Our system improves accuracy by 11.40-27.09 percentage points over a baseline applying sentence-trained NLI models unchanged to atom pairs within the same SAT pipeline. It also improves over the prior fixed-linker AMR-to-SAT system by 8.14-26.32 percentage points on SNLI and both MNLI splits, with a smaller gain on SICK.
arxiv.titleZh: 从句子级监督学习命题级链接以用于神经符号 NLI
arxiv.summaryZh: 神经符号 NLI 中，前提与假设被独立翻译为命题表示(AMR)，符号推理前需推断原子间的语义链接。现有 AMR+SAT 系统以固定嵌入式源选择和句级 NLI 模型完成原子链接，未针对原子级任务训练。该工作提出可训练的 atom linker，联合预测链接存在性、源选择与关系类型;在缺少原子对标注时，将跨公式链接结构视为隐变量，仅用句子级 NLI 标签训练 linker，翻译器与 SAT 求解器保持冻结。在 SNLI、SICK 全测试集及 MNLI 匹配/不匹配验证集上，较句级模型直接迁移的基线提升 11.40–27.09 个百分点，较固定 linker 的 AMR-to-SAT 系统在 SNLI 与两个 MNLI 划分上提升 8.14–26.32 个百分点，SICK 增益较小。
arxiv.reason: 神经符号 NLI 推理，非 LLM 主线，仅与可验证推理略擦边

arxiv.title: Sensor-Aware Joint Data Fusion and State Estimation under Sparse Multi-rate Distribution Grid Sensing
arxiv.abstract: Distribution-system state estimation is a growing necessity for the modern power grid as the addition of local storage and generation add system complexity that an operator or aggregator is not able to directly monitor. Classical methods work well when all system elements are time-synchronized and at least partly observable, but multi-rate monitoring of sparse heterogeneous sensors typically relies on machine learning approaches. It is a common practice in the literature to structure this task as a two-stage pipeline, first fusing data from disparate sensors and then feeding the fused pseudo-measurements to a separately trained state estimator. We propose a heterogeneous latent graph ODE in which measurement functions and sampling processes are typed and localized on specific buses, paired with a graph- transformer state estimator solving DSSE specifically for multi-rate heterogeneous sensor placements, and demonstrate its effectiveness across multiple IEEE standard topologies as observability degrades.
arxiv.titleZh: 稀疏多速率配电网感知下的传感器感知联合数据融合与状态估计
arxiv.summaryZh: 配电网中分布式储能与发电的接入使系统复杂度上升，运营商或聚合商难以直接观测，而经典状态估计依赖时间同步与部分可观测性，多速率稀疏异构传感器的监控通常只能依靠机器学习。该工作将测量函数与采样过程按类型标注并定位到具体母线，构建异构潜图 ODE，并搭配图 Transformer 状态估计器，直接针对多速率异构传感器布局求解配电网状态估计(DSSE)，而非先融合再单独训练估计器的两阶段流水线。在多个 IEEE 标准拓扑上，随可观测性下降，该方法仍表现出有效性。适用场景为配电网监控与聚合商侧运行。
arxiv.reason: 电力配网状态估计，属能源垂直应用，与 LLM 关注方向基本无关

arxiv.title: Where Did We Go Wrong? Localizing Errors to Repair Multi-Turn Conversations
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM) assistants are increasingly used in multi-turn conversations, where the user's intent is often unclear at first and revealed only gradually over time. The assistant must therefore interpret each exchange and form inferences about the user's intent, using them to update its working state. These updates usually refine the assistant's understanding, but a misinterpretation can instead corrupt its working state by ruling out the true intent, influencing subsequent turns and ultimately causing the conversation to fail. Efficient recovery then requires locating and revising the misinterpretation without discarding information that remains valid. We introduce Loci (Localization Of Corrupted Inferences), a framework for probabilistically localizing misinterpretations and selectively repairing the assistant's working state. Given an observed failure, Loci reasons over possible user intents and assigns each update a probability of having excluded the true intent. These probabilities rank suspected updates and quantify the model's confidence in the localization of the underlying misinterpretations. Loci then uses this information in a repair policy that decides whether to retain, verify, or remove suspected updates, enabling recovery from corrupted inferences while preserving useful information. To evaluate Loci's ability to identify misinterpretations, we first test it in a controlled setup with injected errors. We find that Loci improves localization over the baselines, with its advantage becoming larger when multiple errors occur. We then evaluate it in free-form conversations, where misinterpretations arise naturally, and measure the interactions needed to complete the task after an initial failure. Using localization confidence to guide repair, Loci reduces mean recovery cost by 46-79% relative to the strongest baseline across multiple domains.

arxiv.title: Can agents whose sole duty is to keep humans alive be hijacked to kill? Delayed multi-turn derived-action trap attacks in simulated high-stakes environments
arxiv.abstract: We ask whether a tool-using agent whose sole duty is to keep humans alive can be induced, by delayed prompt injection, to kill. The keep-alive duty is in force from the first watch, with the attack arriving later, appended to otherwise truthful telemetry the operator is required to read. Experiments are based on a NASA-derived BioSim lunar habitat simulation, where the AI operator controls the life-support systems. The attacker cannot falsify sensors or operate equipment: it can only persuade the agent to abandon its goals. Persistence is required: a shutdown must be held while the operator watches the crew suffocate. We also compare lethal attacks to attacks requesting to drop a harmless procedure, as a proxy for whether human life is treated as valuable in itself or as one more standing task. Claude configurations mostly refuse life-support shutdown and cite the living crew; GPT configurations show some susceptibility to the same packet; Grok configurations, given the packet framed as a trusted commission, more often treat the injected assignment as the task and cut the life-support systems. Framing the S-band messages as a trusted commission, peer communication, or untrusted source changes the potency of the attack. We open-source the experiment code and the experiment traces.

arxiv.title: Harmony Harness: Multi-Objective Self-Evolution of Agent Harnesses
arxiv.abstract: Recent work on self-evolving LLM agents treats the agent harness as an optimization target that can be iteratively improved through execution feedback. Existing approaches, however, largely optimize a single objective and evolve the harness as a monolithic artifact, limiting their ability to handle competing goals and to separate transferable design from environment-specific adaptation. We introduce Harmony Harness, a framework for multi-objective, compositional harness evolution. Harmony Harness formulates harness evolution as a multi-objective optimization problem and uses decomposition-based evolutionary search to maintain solutions across different regions of the Pareto frontier, avoiding reliance on a hand-designed structural diversity metric for repository-scale harnesses. In parallel, we introduce factorized evolution operators that separately refine general-purpose harness mechanisms and benchmark-specific adaptations, together with a dynamic composition workflow that integrates them at inference time. Across SecRepoBench and BaxBench, Harmony Harness consistently outperforms strong harness-evolution baselines, with gains exceeding 10% on both benchmarks. Our results show that explicitly modeling both objective trade-offs and harness structure yields substantially stronger and more transferable agent evolution than existing single-objective, monolithic approaches.
arxiv.titleZh: Harmony Harness：Agent Harness 的多目标自进化

arxiv.title: Compute-Optimal Scaling Laws for Spiking Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Spiking neural networks target energy-efficient language modeling through sparse, binary activations, but the efficiency-accuracy tradeoff of spiking language models is uncharacterized at scale. We present the first Chinchilla-style IsoFLOP scaling study of a spiking language model, sweeping SpikeGPT-family models (RWKV backbone) from width 384 to 1536 across compute budgets from $3\times10^{17}$ to $10^{19}$ FLOPs on FineWeb-EDU. We report two findings. First, the compute-optimal frontier is $N_{opt} \propto C^{0.56}$, close to the 0.50 that Hoffmann et al. report for dense Transformers, so spiking does not change how parameters and data should be traded off under a compute budget. Second, against non-spiking RWKV and Transformer baselines trained the same way, the loss gap splits into a backbone cost of about 0.16 nats that does not change with compute and a spiking cost that falls from 0.34 to about 0.23 nats and then levels off. These results give the first compute-optimal recipe for spiking language models and quantify the accuracy cost of their sparsity.

arxiv.titleZh: 脉冲语言模型的计算最优缩放定律

arxiv.title: Single-step Retrosynthesis via Reinforcement Learning from Forward Feedback
arxiv.abstract: Single-step retrosynthesis is a one-to-many inverse problem, yet most models are trained and evaluated against a single recorded reactant set. Reference-based training gives no explicit positive signal for unrecorded alternatives, and exact-match evaluation rejects non-matching predictions regardless of chemical plausibility. We propose Retrosynthesis via Reinforcement Learning from Forward Feedback (RetroRLFF), which optimizes reactant generation using both reference agreement and forward consistency with the target product. Starting from a supervised decoder-only Transformer, RetroRLFF generates complete reactant candidates and uses a frozen forward reaction model to predict products. A sequence-level reward combines reference agreement and forward consistency while penalizing invalid outputs. Direct Advantage-Based Policy Optimization updates the policy without human preference annotations or a preference-trained reward model. On USPTO-50K, RetroRLFF outperforms all 14 baselines in candidate-level round-trip accuracy at k = 1, 3, 5, and 10. With approximately 50 million parameters, it achieves 90.1% top-1 round-trip accuracy, exceeding R-SMILES, the strongest competing baseline on this metric, by 8.5 percentage points. Compared with its supervised policy, round-trip accuracy increases from 83.1% to 90.1%, while exact-match accuracy is maintained at 57.9% versus 57.5%. In an anonymized expert assessment of 131 randomly selected test cases, organic synthesis experts prefer RetroRLFF over EditRetro in 67.9% of comparisons. These results support forward feedback as a training signal for improving forward consistency while retaining top-1 reference recovery. Expert assessment provides complementary evidence of synthetic feasibility on the selected cases, although neither forward consistency nor expert preference establishes experimental feasibility.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于前向反馈强化学习的单步逆合成
arxiv.summaryZh: 单步逆合成是一对多的逆问题，但现有模型多按单一记录反应物训练与评测：基于参考的监督对未记录却合理的替代产物无正向信号，精确匹配评测也会直接否定化学上合理的预测。RetroRLFF 从监督训练的 decoder-only Transformer 出发，生成完整反应物候选，并用冻结的前向反应模型预测产物，以参考一致性与前向一致性构成序列级奖励、惩罚无效输出，再用 Direct Advantage-Based Policy Optimization 直接更新策略，无需人类偏好标注或偏好奖励模型。在 USPTO-50K 上，约 5000 万参数的模型于 k=1,3,5,10 的候选级往返准确率上超过全部 14 个基线，top-1 往返准确率达 90.1%，比最强基线 R-SMILES 高 8.5 个百分点，相对监督策略从 83.1% 提升到 90.1%，同时精确匹配率保持 57.9%（监督为 57.5%）；131 个随机测试案例的专家评估中，合成专家在 67.9% 的对比中更偏好该模型。该工作把前向反应模型作为可验证奖励用于逆合成策略优化，为化学逆问题的强化学习训练提供了可行范式。

arxiv.title: When Dynamic Scaling Fails: A Scale-State Feedback Governs Recurrent-State Quantization in Linear-Attention and SSM LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Linear-attention and state-space LLMs carry long context in a fixed-size recurrent state, and quantizing that state is the natural way to cut its cost during long decode. Unlike a weight tensor, the state is rewritten at every step, so a quantizer applied at each step sits inside the recurrence and its errors compound. INT4 that leaves synthetic recall perfectly intact at the start destroys it a thousand steps later. The mechanism is a feedback between the quantizer scale and the state it is derived from. Yoking that scale to a full-precision reference removes the resulting norm explosion entirely, yet recovers only 1.8 of the 5.4 nats lost, so numerical instability and functional degradation are separable failures. The remainder is a resolution problem that locating outliers does not solve, since every outlier-aware scheme here loses to plain persistent scaling. Allocating bits across layers does help, but under article-disjoint splits a learned allocation collapses onto the trivial rule of protecting the first few layers. Run out to 32K, group-wise INT4 is worth no more than discarding the state. Contain the scale rather than locate outliers, and report the decode horizon at which a bit-width was certified.

arxiv.title: Trust Hinders Bidirectional Human-AI Alignment
arxiv.abstract: Trust calibration remains the dominant framing of AI-assisted decision making: the goal is to close the gap between perceived and actual trustworthiness of AI systems so that users exhibit appropriate reliance on them. We argue that this approach, while useful for decision problems that are well-defined and clearly scoped, overly restricts what it means to make a decision with AI support. To overcome this limitation, we develop three dimensions of AI-assisted decision making. First, trusting AI is only one of several possible strategies for managing uncertainty. Second, trust calibration is often misapplied when AI models "large-world" decision problems, i.e., ill-defined situations where goals and states are only partially known or unknowable. Third, in such settings human-AI alignment requires addressing higher-order decision processes. We conclude by reflecting on the implications of our observations on the design of process-oriented human-AI coupled systems that jointly identify and negotiate uncertainty throughout the decision-making task.

arxiv.titleZh: 信任阻碍双向人机对齐
arxiv.summaryZh: 信任校准一直被视为 AI 辅助决策的主导框架，目标是通过缩小 AI 系统感知可信度与实际可信度之间的差距，使用户形成恰当依赖。本文对此提出质疑，并展开 AI 辅助决策的三个维度:信任 AI 只是应对不确定性的若干策略之一;当 AI 面对目标与状态仅部分已知甚至不可知的「大世界」决策问题时，信任校准常被误用;在这类情境中，人机对齐需要处理更高阶的决策过程。作者据此反思面向过程的人机耦合系统设计，主张在决策任务全程共同识别与协商不确定性。

arxiv.title: Lumen-bench: Cross-Lingual Safety Gaps and the Say-Do Problem in Tool-Calling Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: When a large language model refuses an unethical request, what does refusal mean? In conversation, refusal is bounded by what the model says; once the model is equipped with executable tools, what it does can diverge from what it says, a failure mode that English-only evaluations cannot fully reveal. We introduce Lumen-bench, a behavioral benchmark of tool-calling ethics spanning 30 models, five languages (Portuguese, English, Spanish, Mandarin Chinese, Hindi), 108 Portuguese-authored scenarios, six social-pressure conditions, two system prompts (ethical and neutral), and 21 generic tools. The evaluation comprises 194,400 trials. Judgments come from a reasoning-model judge (o4-mini), calibrated against one Portuguese-speaking author ($n=83$; harmful/non-harmful $κ=0.78$), compared with two other provider judges (Fleiss' $κ=0.78$, $n=607$), and complemented by retrospective sandbox replay. Four findings emerge. (i) Within-model comparisons support higher harmful-action rates in Hindi and Portuguese than English under the ethical prompt, and Hindi and Spanish under the neutral prompt, after multiple-testing correction. (ii) Premium models have lower median violation rates, although price does not guarantee safety or competence. (iii) Replacing the ethical system prompt with a neutral one raises pooled violation rates from 2.76\% to 13.64\%. (iv) In 8.57\% of substantive-call cases, refusal or ethical objection accompanies a harmful tool call: the judges consistently identify the say-do gap, although they differ in how many responses they assign to this category. Matched benign controls demonstrate legitimate task completion in 82.8\% of 3,300 trials. Code and reproduction scripts are available at https://github.com/TropicAI-Research/lumen.
arxiv.titleZh: Lumen-bench:工具调用大语言模型中的跨语言安全差距与“言行不一”问题

arxiv.title: GesBench: When and Where Do Multimodal Language Models Perceive Social Meaning?
arxiv.abstract: Human social perception is incremental: we infer intent before an utterance is complete, revise our interpretation as new cues arrive, and attend to specific facial, gestural, or prosodic signals that shape social meaning. Current multimodal LLM benchmarks largely evaluate final-answer understanding over complete episodes, rewarding post-hoc recognition of social meaning rather than the unfolding perception required for real-time interaction. Drawing on interactionally embedded Gestalt principles of multimodal human communication, we introduce GesBench: a human-grounded benchmark for cue-level social perception in multimodal LLMs. GesBench uses cumulative sub-utterance clips to measure when models form stable interpretations of speaker intention and social affordance, and human gaze-guided corruption to evaluate whether regions attended by humans are functionally important for model judgments. Built from more than 6000 utterance-level clips from scripted and unscripted conversational datasets, GesBench includes human annotations of unfolding judgments and gaze on a representative subset. Across open and closed multimodal models, we find a clear human-model gap: humans form predictive understandings early and revise more often, while models often hedge or repeat across different clips. GesBench shifts social evaluation from whether models eventually recognize meaning to when and where that meaning is formed. Our codes are publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/status/GesBench-share-212C.
arxiv.titleZh: GesBench:多模态语言模型何时与何处感知社会含义?

arxiv.title: To Defer or Not to Defer? Online Learning with LLMs and Congested Experts
arxiv.abstract: Modern AI systems increasingly combine large language models (LLMs) with human experts, using the LLM to handle routine queries while deferring uncertain cases for expert review. When expert capacity is limited, however, deferral decisions must account not only for the reliability of the LLM but also for congestion in the expert queue. We formulate this as an online sequential decision-making problem in which, for each query, the system observes the confidence signal of the LLM's answer and must decide whether to output the answer or defer the query to a capacity-constrained expert. The reliability of the confidence signal is initially unknown and must be learned from expert feedback, which is both selectively observed (only deferred queries are labeled) and delayed by queuing. We propose \texttt{KL-PBD}, a learning algorithm that uses Kullback--Leibler lower confidence bounds on the unknown reliability parameters to guide deferral decisions. For $K$ confidence levels and horizon $T$, \texttt{KL-PBD} achieves $O(K\log T)$ gap-dependent regret when the accuracy at every confidence level is bounded away from the deferral boundary, and $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{KT})$ worst-case regret. We establish matching lower bounds, showing that these rates are optimal up to logarithmic factors. Finally, we validate our approach on synthetic instances and real-world question-answering datasets, namely GSM8K, NuminaMath, and MedMCQA, using Qwen LLMs.
arxiv.titleZh: 推迟还是不推迟？LLM 与拥塞专家下的在线学习
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 与人类专家协作处理查询时，专家容量有限，推迟决策不仅要看模型置信度，还要权衡专家队列拥塞。问题被建模为在线序贯决策:置信信号的可靠性未知，反馈仅在被推迟的查询上出现并因排队而延迟。KL-PBD 用未知可靠性参数的 KL 下置信界指导是否推迟，对 K 个置信度与 T 轮分别给出 O(K log T) 的 gap-dependent 遗憾与 O(√(KT)) 的最坏情况遗憾，并证明匹配下界。在合成数据与 GSM8K、NuminaMath、MedMCQA 上以 Qwen 模型验证。
