arxiv.title: ShellElastic: Scalable Elastic Pretraining with Simultaneous Maximal Updates and Hyperparameter Transfer
arxiv.abstract: Foundation models need to support diverse inference budgets, yet training a separate model for each budget duplicates pretraining effort. Elastic models train several nested sub-networks inside one weight-shared supernet, but existing recipes face three obstacles: variable per-step workloads that hinder distributed scaling, limited hyperparameter (HP) transfer across model sizes, and no guarantee that all sub-networks are maximally updated at once. We present \Ours, an elastic transformer that organizes hidden dimensions into a dense core and successive shells, so that every hidden matrix is block lower triangular. One full-width forward pass contains every sub-network's exact hidden states as prefixes, so joint training keeps a fixed computation graph and costs about as much per step as training the widest sub-network alone. We further introduce \muE, an extension of maximal update parameterization (\mup) to \Ours and other elastic architectures. Its scaling rules provably keep all sub-networks of a supernet maximally updated simultaneously (\muI), and keep doing so when the supernet is widened or given more shells; sweeps confirm that HPs tuned on a small non-elastic proxy stay near-optimal for elastic families and larger supernets (\mbox{\muT}). A single \Ours run produces sub-networks that outperform MatFormer and fully elastic baselines at matched parameter counts, and approach separately trained models that together take several times the steps.
arxiv.titleZh: ShellElastic:同时实现最大化更新与超参数迁移的可扩展弹性预训练
arxiv.summaryZh: 基础模型需适配多种推理预算，而为每个预算单独训练模型会重复预训练开销。ShellElastic 将隐藏维度组织为稠密核心与逐层外壳，使每个隐藏矩阵呈块下三角结构，一次全宽前向即包含所有子网的精确隐藏状态前缀，联合训练保持固定计算图，每步开销约等于只训最宽子网。作者进一步提出 μE，把最大更新参数化 μP 扩展到弹性架构，证明其缩放规则能让超级网的全部子网同时被最大化更新，且在加宽或增加外壳后仍成立。单次训练所得子网在同等参数量下优于 MatFormer 与全弹性基线，并接近需数倍步数分别训练的模型。
arxiv.reason: 新弹性架构加 μP 超参迁移，直击预训练与高效训练方向

arxiv.title: scHFBiMamba: a bidirectional Mamba autoencoder for cardiac disease-state classification from single-nucleus RNA-seq data
arxiv.abstract: To evaluate whether a compact bidirectional state-space autoencoder improves joint classification of species, cell type, and disease state from single-nucleus RNA-sequencing profiles in heart failure (HF), while yielding interpretable gene attributions. Building on the dense denoising autoencoder (DAE) and MLP framework of Ruz Jurado et al., we developed scHFBiMamba, combining a bidirectional Mamba autoencoder (BiMambaAE) with an MLP head. BiMambaAE maps 16,545-gene profiles to 350-dimensional latent representations using 13.2M parameters, about 14.6-fold fewer than the dense DAE (192.9M). We compared six encoder-classifier configurations on 38,275 held-out cardiac nuclei using McNemar tests with Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and assessed nine classifiers on frozen representations. Biological relevance was evaluated by comparing SHAP-derived differentially explained genes with differentially expressed genes against curated HF-related Gene Ontology keywords. BiMambaAE+MLP achieved the highest aggregate F1: pooled macro-F1 across 13 outputs was 0.966 versus 0.957 for DAE+MLP, and the mean category macro-F1 was 0.977 versus 0.970. It significantly improved cell-type and disease-state accuracy (adjusted p=7.1e-3 and p=4.8e-6, respectively), with species F1 of 1.000. SHAP-derived differentially explained genes achieved a pathway-enrichment benchmark F1 of 0.105 versus 0.053 for differentially expressed genes. Compact bidirectional state-space autoencoders can outperform substantially larger dense autoencoders for joint cardiac transcriptomic classification while reducing parameters. scHFBiMamba enables accurate multi-task prediction and hypothesis-generating gene-level interpretation. Code: https://github.com/UgoLomoio/scHFBiMamba.
arxiv.titleZh: scHFBiMamba:一种用于单核 RNA 测序数据心脏病状态分类的双向 Mamba 自编码器
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向心力衰竭单核 RNA 测序数据中物种、细胞类型与疾病状态的联合分类，构建 scHFBiMamba，把双向 Mamba 自编码器(BiMambaAE)与 MLP 分类头组合，用 13.2M 参数将 16,545 维基因表达压到 350 维隐空间，参数量比稠密去噪自编码器的 192.9M 少约 14.6 倍。在 38,275 个留出心脏细胞核上，BiMambaAE+MLP 的池化 macro-F1 为 0.966(对比 0.957)，细胞类型与疾病状态准确率显著提升(校正 p=7.1e-3 与 4.8e-6)，物种 F1 为 1.000。SHAP 导出的差异解释基因通路富集 F1 达 0.105，高于差异表达基因的 0.053，为心脏转录组多任务预测与基因层面假设生成提供更省参数的方案。
arxiv.reason: 生物医药垂直应用，仅双向 Mamba 架构略微擦边

arxiv.title: Structural Chain-of-Thought: Reasoning with Executable Computational Graphs
arxiv.abstract: Chain-of-thought prompting enables reasoning in large language models but produces explanations that are difficult to verify, expensive to generate, and not always faithful. We introduce a Structural Chain-of-Thought framework where models generate executable computational graphs instead of free-form reasoning. The final answer is obtained by deterministically executing the graph. The model is trained using graph-based reinforcement learning that rewards structural validity, answer correctness, and node overlap with reference graphs. Experiments across five benchmarks and four model families show that our method consistently improves accuracy over supervised graph training and can reduce generation length by up to 5-6x compared with standard GRPO and chain-of-thought supervised training. Our faithfulness experiments reveal that models trained with our approach tend to rely on deriving their answers from the generated graphs rather than producing post-hoc rationalizations as usually in chain-of-thought reasoning.
arxiv.titleZh: 结构化思维链:用可执行计算图做推理
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对思维链解释难以验证、生成开销大且未必忠实的问题，提出结构化思维链框架:模型不再输出自由文本推理，而是生成可执行计算图，最终答案由图确定性执行得到。训练采用基于图的强化学习，奖励结构合法性、答案正确性以及节点与参考图的重叠度。在五个基准、四类模型上一致优于有监督图训练，生成长度相比标准 GRPO 与思维链监督训练最多缩短 5–6 倍;忠实性实验显示模型倾向由生成的图推导答案，而非像常规思维链那样事后编造理由。
arxiv.reason: 可执行图推理加图结构 RL 奖励，直击后训练与推理忠实性

arxiv.title: RELAGRAM: Recursive Latent Graph Model for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem
arxiv.abstract: Latent recursion repeatedly processes internal representations through the same neural network. Recent work has shown this approach to be effective on structured reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and maze solving. However, whether latent recursion can support neural routing remains unclear. We introduce RELAGRAM (Recursive Latent Graph Model), a novel approach that brings latent recursion to graph combinatorial optimization. RELAGRAM encodes a capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) instance as edge tokens; a compact transformer recurrently updates the latent representations of these tokens. An output head maps the answer state to an edge heatmap, from which an autoregressive decoder constructs a feasible solution. On CVRP-100 instances, the 0.53M-parameter RELAGRAM achieves gaps to a PyVRP reference of 13.4%, 9.8%, and 8.3% under greedy decoding, eightfold symmetry augmentation, and 256-candidate search, respectively. Trained only on CVRP-100, RELAGRAM generalizes zero-shot to CVRP-500 and CVRP-1000, achieving gaps of 15.6% and 21.7% under 256-candidate search. Together, these results demonstrate that latent recursion is a promising approach to neural routing.
arxiv.comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 MLxOR workshop. Paper contains 6 pages (4 main text, 1 references, 1 appendix); 1 figure and 3 tables
arxiv.titleZh: RELAGRAM:面向带容量约束车辆路径问题的递归隐空间图模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 隐式递归让同一网络反复迭代内部表示，已在数独、迷宫等结构化推理任务上见效，但能否支撑神经路径规划仍不清楚。RELAGRAM 把 CVRP 实例编码为边 token，用紧凑 Transformer 循环更新这些 token 的隐表示，再由输出头映射为边热力图，交自回归解码器构造可行解。仅 0.53M 参数时，在 CVRP-100 上相对 PyVRP 参考解的差距为贪心 13.4%、八重对称增强 9.8%、256 候选搜索 8.3%。只在 CVRP-100 上训练即可零样本迁移到 CVRP-500 与 CVRP-1000,256 候选搜索下差距分别为 15.6% 与 21.7%。
arxiv.reason: 神经组合优化加隐式递归，与 LLM 主线仅擦边

arxiv.title: RegExtract: A Benchmark for PFAS Regulatory Information Extraction with LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Extracting structured information from regulatory documents is a critical but challenging task. Relevant facts are scattered across long, legally dense texts, and traceability of extracted facts to their source is essential for verification. With increasing awareness of the environmental and health impacts of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), regulatory documents have expanded significantly, varying in scope and product relevance, making interpretation challenging for manufacturers and policymakers. We introduce RegExtract, a benchmark for structured information extraction from PFAS regulatory documents, comprising 488 human-annotated field instances across 20 US state documents and 46 regulations. Each field instance includes a value and a provenance entry, yielding 976 entries in total. We define a typed, multi-field schema targeting key elements such as material definitions, permitted uses, and product exemptions, and propose provenance-aware evaluation metrics tailored to regulatory text. Through experiments with open- and closed-source LLMs across prompting strategies, document condensing methods, and schema partitioning approaches, we find that document identification fields remain challenging, and that field-specific few-shot examples improve extraction. This work lays the groundwork for AI tools for hazardous substance identification, question answering, and compliance monitoring. The code and data are available at https://github.com/IBM/PFAS-regulations.
arxiv.comment: Accepted to the AI for Law Workshop at ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea
arxiv.titleZh: RegExtract：一个用 LLM 抽取 PFAS 法规信息的基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向 PFAS 法规文档条款分散、需可溯源的结构化抽取需求，构建 RegExtract 基准：覆盖美国20个州文档与46项法规，含488个人工标注字段实例、每条带值与出处，共976条；定义类型化多字段 schema（材料定义、允许用途、产品豁免等）并提出面向溯源的评估指标。在开源与闭源 LLM 上比较提示策略、文档压缩与 schema 切分，发现文档标识类字段仍难抽取，字段级 few-shot 示例可提升效果。为危险物质识别、法规问答与合规监测提供依据。
arxiv.reason: 法规信息抽取基准，沾评测方法学但属垂直应用且为 workshop 论文

arxiv.title: Random Feature Pruning for Multi-Class Classification
arxiv.abstract: Weighted sums of random kitchen sinks (W-RKS) is a commonly used feature extraction technique for supervised learning tasks. A major drawback of this method is the redundancy and ineffectiveness of many extracted random features. This paper investigates efficient methods for reducing such redundancy in multi-class classification problems. We specifically formulate feature selection as a variant of the sequentially nested model selection problem and introduce the Successive Empirical Excess Risk Difference Maximization (SEED-MAX) algorithm. It recursively computes empirical risks to identify the most parsimonious yet informative set of features. We derive an analytical lower bound for the probability of correct feature selection by the SEED-MAX algorithm. This lower bound on the probability of correct feature selection can be made arbitrarily close to one by increasing the training dataset size. To further enhance the rate of pruning, we evaluate the features retained by SEED-MAX using the Fisher test (F-Test). Empirical evaluations on UCR time-series classification datasets show that the sequential application of SEED-MAX with the Fisher test achieves approximately 92 percent rate of pruning with negligible degradation in classification accuracy. Implementations of the SEED-MAX and SEED-MAX-F-Test methods are available at https://github.com/OmidiAmin/seed-max-ftest.
arxiv.comment: 43 Pages, 6 Figures
arxiv.titleZh: 多类分类中的随机特征剪枝
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对随机厨房水槽加权和(W-RKS)特征提取中大量随机特征冗余、低效的问题，把特征选择表述为序贯嵌套模型选择的一个变体，提出 SEED-MAX 算法:递归计算经验风险，筛选出最精简而具信息量的特征子集，并给出正确选择特征概率的解析下界，该下界随训练集规模增大可任意逼近 1。进一步用 Fisher 检验对 SEED-MAX 保留的特征做二次筛选，在 UCR 时间序列分类数据集上以约 92% 的剪枝率取得几乎无损的分类精度。
arxiv.reason: 随机特征剪枝的经典统计方法，与 LLM 关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: Anchors Enhance Controllability and Reasoning of Diffusion Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer new opportunities for controllable text generation. However, their controllability, defined as the ability to satisfy task constraints while preserving their original capabilities, remains underexplored. DLMs' bidirectional attention allows control tokens to guide generation from arbitrary positions in the output sequence, but effective guidance depends on the compatibility between their content and placement. To this end, we propose AnchorDLM, a framework in which an anchor generator produces an anchor consisting of a short output fragment and its position for each query. The anchor is placed as control tokens at the specified position to initialize the output sequence of a frozen DLM and guide subsequent denoising. We train the anchor generator with reinforcement learning (RL) to jointly optimize anchor content and placement, using rewards computed from the DLM's generated outputs based on answer correctness and constraint satisfaction. Moreover, through the lens of discrete flow matching (DFM), we interpret anchor placement as helping to reshape the initial velocity field that guides generation. Experiments on code generation and mathematical reasoning across five DLM backbones show that AnchorDLM improves controllability and further yields gains in reasoning performance across diverse benchmarks.
arxiv.titleZh: 锚点增强扩散语言模型的可控性与推理能力
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对扩散语言模型在满足任务约束的同时保持原有能力这一可控性问题，AnchorDLM 用锚点生成器为每个查询产出一小段输出片段及其位置组成的锚点，将其作为控制 token 插入指定位置，初始化冻结 DLM 的输出序列并引导后续去噪;锚点生成器通过强化学习联合优化内容与位置，奖励来自答案正确性与约束满足度，并从离散流匹配角度把锚点放置解释为重塑初始速度场。在五个 DLM 骨干上的代码生成与数学推理实验中，该方法提升了可控性，并在多个基准上带来推理性能增益。
arxiv.reason: 扩散语言模型属低分方向，仅 RL 与推理沾边

arxiv.title: Swarm Telepathy: Prefill-Free KV-Cache Transfer Across Families
arxiv.abstract: LLM multi-agent systems split work across agents that communicate through text. An agent summarizes its findings, another agent receives the text. This constrains communication to discrete tokens and costs redundant compute, limiting bandwidth and capabilities of multi-agent systems. Recent works demonstrate KV-cache transfer between LLMs but they either require the LLMs to be within the same family or cannot function across context, thus requiring the receiver to prefill text. We present SwaT (Swarm Telepathy), the first cross-family KV-cache transfer method that allows prefill-free communication in multi-family multi-agent systems. In an agent-to-agent communication setting, combining SwaT with recent advances in KV-cache compaction beats text-to-text communication in both accuracy and speed, with a mean of $40\%$ higher accuracy and a mean of $4\times$ faster wall-clock time. Experiments show SwaT achieves high performance on 17 benchmarks across 12 LLMs and 6 families. Additionally, given a sender Vision-Language Model (VLM), SwaT is able to transfer the vision capabilities to a text-only receiver LLM exceeding text-to-text communication despite SwaT being trained on text-only data. SwaT keeps both sender and receiver models frozen without fine-tuning and only requires $<50M$ tokens and $<1$ GPU-day to train.
arxiv.titleZh: Swarm Telepathy:跨模型族的免预填充 KV-Cache 传输
arxiv.summaryZh: 多智能体系统目前只能靠文本 token 通信，带宽受限且需重复计算;已有的 KV-cache 传输方法要么要求收发双方同属一个模型族，要么仍无法跨上下文、需接收方预填充。SwaT 是首个跨模型族的 KV-cache 传输方法，收发双方模型全部冻结、不做微调，仅需不到 50M token 与不到 1 GPU-day 训练，即可把压缩后的 KV cache 直接注入接收方实现免预填充通信。在 agent 间通信场景中配合 KV-cache 压缩，准确率平均提升 40%，墙钟时间平均快 4 倍，并在 12 个 LLM、6 个模型族、17 个 benchmark 上验证;当发送方是 VLM 时，还能把视觉能力迁移给纯文本接收方并超越文本通信。
arxiv.reason: 跨模型族 KV-cache 免预填充通信，直接命中 Agent 与推理效率方向

arxiv.title: TurnCost: Turns, Not Observations: Cache-Aware Loop Engineering for Coding Agents
arxiv.abstract: AI coding agents operate in iterative loops: they modify code, run tools, inspect the results, and decide what to do next. We call the design of this process loop engineering, which includes context management, model selection, compaction, and termination. Existing efficiency work mainly compresses tool observations or routes selected turns to cheaper models, but the practical opportunity for these optimizations remains unclear. We analyze 600 publicly released coding-agent trajectories spanning two agent scaffolds and two language models. Median observations contain only 118-286 tokens, while the large build logs commonly used to motivate compression occur near the ninety-ninth percentile. Moreover, 98.6% of input tokens are served from a prefix cache, so flat input pricing overestimates loop cost by roughly 7x on average under near-ideal caching. We derive and empirically validate a closed-form break-even condition for model delegation. Delegation increases cost in half of the evaluated settings, near the predicted boundary. More broadly, turn count explains 84% of the variance in log trajectory cost, compared with 4% for mean observation size; the most expensive trajectories have the most turns despite having the smallest observations. These associations suggest that observation-focused methods target a secondary cost factor, and identify unnecessary turns as the larger and largely unexamined opportunity, though we do not establish that turns can be removed while holding task success fixed. We release TurnCost, a tool for re-scoring trajectory corpora under alternative caching, pricing, compression, and routing policies.
arxiv.titleZh: TurnCost:是轮次而非观测——面向编码智能体的缓存感知循环工程
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对编码智能体的循环式运行开销，分析 600 条公开轨迹（2 种 scaffold、2 种模型）发现：观测中位长度仅 118–286 token，常被用来论证压缩的大构建日志其实接近第 99 百分位；98.6% 的输入 token 由前缀缓存命中，扁平计费平均高估约 7 倍循环成本。据此推导并验证了模型委派路由的闭式盈亏平衡条件，半数设置下委派反而更贵。回归显示轮数解释 84% 的轨迹成本方差，平均观测大小仅 4%。作者发布 TurnCost，可在不同缓存、定价、压缩与路由策略下重算轨迹语料成本，指出砍掉无效轮次比压缩观测更值得优化。
arxiv.reason: 编码 Agent 循环成本实证分析，直击 Agent 效率与缓存定价

arxiv.title: Have You Been Convinced? A Neuro-symbolic Argumentation Reasoning Approach to Detecting Persuasiveness in ChangeMyView Discussions
arxiv.abstract: Argument structures represent how individual arguments interact within a discourse. However, leveraging these structures to infer meaningful knowledge remains challenging, as it requires a formal representation of how argumentative influence propagates across the structure. We propose Neuro-symbolic Argumentation Reasoning System (NARS) for performing persuasiveness detection directly from online discussions. The neural component employs retrieval-augmented iterative LLM reasoning to extract bipolar argument structures, while the symbolic component applies gradual argumentation semantics to propagate argumentative influence over the structure. Using the Webis-CMV-20 corpus, we construct CMV2BAS, a dataset of long, multi-threaded ChangeMyView discussions annotated with LLM-derived bipolar argument structures and labeled with delta events (view change vs.\ no change). We investigate whether gradual argumentation semantics can effectively detect persuasiveness, whether augmenting them with argument quality and graph-based centrality improves performance, and whether symbolic reasoning remains necessary in the presence of modern LLMs. NARS achieves F1=0.57 and AUC=0.56 under its best configuration, outperforming zero-shot Qwen3.6:27B and GPT-oss:20B. We identify support-dominant discussions and long argumentative chains as key failure modes limiting attack influence propagation. Our work demonstrates the feasibility of operationalizing formal gradual argumentation semantics over noisy real-world discourse for scalable macro-level persuasion analysis, while highlighting key challenges and directions for future research in neuro-symbolic argumentation reasoning. We release both CMV2BAS dataset and the NARS framework for public use.
arxiv.comment: Accepted and to be published in the Proceedings of the 25th International Conference on Knowledge Engineering and Knowledge Management (EKAW 2026)
arxiv.titleZh: 你被说服了吗？一种用于检测 ChangeMyView 讨论中说服力的神经符号论证推理方法
arxiv.summaryZh: 从在线讨论中直接检测说服力，难点在于形式化建模论证影响力如何在论证结构中传播。神经符号论证推理系统 NARS 用检索增强的迭代 LLM 推理抽取双极论证结构，再以渐进论证语义在该结构上传播论证影响力;基于 Webis-CMV-20 构建的 CMV2BAS 数据集带有 LLM 导出的双极论证结构与 delta 事件标注。最佳配置下 F1=0.57、AUC=0.56，优于零样本 Qwen3.6:27B 与 GPT-oss:20B，并指出支持占优的讨论与长论证链是攻击影响力传播的主要失效模式。工作验证了在嘈杂真实语料上运行形式化渐进论证语义做宏观说服分析的可行性，数据集与框架已公开。
arxiv.reason: 神经符号加 LLM 推理，但落在说服力检测这一社科垂直应用，指标偏弱

arxiv.title: Self-Evolving Visual Agent via Margin Reward
arxiv.abstract: Visual agents that interleave reasoning with tool invocation have posed a promising direction for multimodal tasks. However, learning effective tool invocation usually relies on curated question-answer pairs or expert demonstrations at scale, which are expensive to acquire. In this study, we propose Marvo, a simple-yet-effective self-evolution approach that enables learning tool invocation from unlabeled images. Marvo consists of two agents: (1) a challenger that generates question-answer pairs from unlabeled images, and (2) a solver that learns tool invocation by solving questions through reinforcement learning. To encourage effective tool invocation, a good training question should be difficult enough to warrant tool use, yet remain within the solver's capabilities. To this end, we introduce a margin reward to the challenger, defined as solver's performance difference with and without access to tools. With the margin reward, we create an adaptive curriculum that encourages the solver to learn effective tool invocation. Across benchmarks covering agentic reasoning, visual search, mathematical, and general real-world reasoning, Marvo improves average accuracy by up to 7.1\% --- demonstrating margin reward as a preferred way to scale question complexity without human supervision.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于边际奖励的自进化视觉智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 视觉智能体的工具调用训练通常依赖大规模人工标注问答对或专家演示，获取成本高昂。Marvo 用两个智能体实现自进化:challenger 从无标签图像生成问答对，solver 通过强化学习解题来学习工具调用;并提出边际奖励，即 solver 在有工具与无工具时的表现差，以此驱动 challenger 生成「难到需要工具、又在 solver 能力范围内」的题目，形成自适应课程。在智能体推理、视觉搜索、数学与通用真实世界推理基准上平均准确率最高提升 7.1%，说明边际奖励是无需人工监督扩展问题复杂度的可行路径。
arxiv.reason: 自进化 Agentic RL，边际奖励设计新颖，命中后训练与 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Knowledge transfer between simple discrete worlds
arxiv.abstract: Adapting to a new world and reasoning correctly about which outcomes are possible under rules one has not met before is a basic capacity underlying general intelligence. We study it in small discrete worlds: sets of grid configurations consistent with a shared set of rules, concretely Sudoku-like puzzles built from a common base and a handful of extra rules. We train a single depth-recurrent model on many combinations of rules and test it at four levels of novelty: a new puzzle, a new combination of known rules, a pairing of rules never seen together, and a rule instance not seen at all during training. The model receives the active rules either as a symbolic description or as two solved examples, and a model that gets no rule information is used as a baseline. At recombining rules it was trained on, the description matches or exceeds examples ($99\%$ against $95\%$ on new combinations). On rule instances whose components never co-occurred in training, the description falls below the no-information baseline while examples stay above it. The framework allows us to test many such generalization regimes in more systematic way than benchmarks such as ARC-AGI and provides new ground for evaluating depth-recurrent reasoning models, which are typically tested on saturated Sudoku benchmarks.
arxiv.titleZh: 简单离散世界之间的知识迁移

arxiv.title: On the Theoretical Limits of Learning Unconstrained Interatomic Potentials
arxiv.abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) accelerate molecular dynamics (MD) simulations by learning the energies and forces that govern atomic motion. Recent work has shown that relaxing physical inductive biases can improve computational efficiency and predictive accuracy, raising the question of whether energy-and-force matching alone is sufficient to ensure accurate sampling. We show that, for unconstrained hypothesis classes, the relationship between prediction error and sampling accuracy is exponentially ill-conditioned in dimension. In particular, prediction errors that decay exponentially with dimension can coexist with nearly maximal total variation distance between the learned and target distributions. We identify two failure mechanisms. The first is kinetic trapping, where relaxation to an accurate learned equilibrium requires exponentially long times, even when simulations are initialized from training configurations at which energies and forces are matched exactly. The second is equilibrium mismatch, where the learned stationary distribution itself remains far from the target. Under explicit assumptions, we show that equilibrium mismatch can persist even in local, symmetry-preserving models, where small per-atom errors coexist with a distributional discrepancy that approaches its maximum as system size increases. Finally, we establish global energy-control conditions that guarantee equilibrium accuracy and identify additional conditions required for rapid relaxation.
arxiv.titleZh: 论学习无约束原子间势的理论极限
arxiv.summaryZh: 机器学习原子间势(MLIP)通过拟合能量与力来加速分子动力学模拟，但仅靠能量-力匹配是否足以保证采样正确一直存疑。该工作从理论上证明，对无约束假设类，预测误差与采样精度之间的关系在维度上呈指数级病态:预测误差随维度指数衰减时，学习分布与目标分布的总变差距离仍可接近最大。作者指出两种失效机制——动力学俘获(即使从精确匹配能量与力的训练构型出发，弛豫到正确平衡也需指数级时间)与平衡失配(学习到的平稳分布本身远离目标，且随体系增大趋近最大差异)，并给出保证平衡精度的全局能量控制条件及快速弛豫所需的附加条件。

arxiv.title: Toward a Multimodal Foundation Model for Plasma State Reconstruction
arxiv.abstract: Plasma experiments observe coupled physical states through sparse, heterogeneous, and incomplete diagnostics. We present a proof of concept toward a multimodal foundation model for plasma state reconstruction during magnetic reconnection, motivated by the Facility for Laboratory Reconnection Experiments (FLARE). Using 250 synthetic VPIC simulations at fixed reference electron beta $β_{e0}=0.2$, with 225 training runs and 25 disjoint validation runs, we train a 5.5M-parameter residual 3D U-Net to reconstruct three magnetic-field components and electron density from incomplete observations. The model combines spatial-only pooling, which preserves all 24 temporal frames, with global spatiotemporal self-attention and rotary positional encoding. Independently masking magnetic and density modalities across random, grid, block, and temporal patterns enables sparse sensing, cross-modal completion, density super-resolution, and temporal completion with a single set of weights and no task-specific retraining. With density fully hidden, just 0.1% magnetic spatial visibility reduces median density NRMSE from approximately 0.9 to 0.1. Conversely, observed density improves current-density reconstruction when magnetic data are absent or extremely sparse. With no magnetic observations, roughly 1% density visibility approaches the density reconstruction accuracy achieved with fully observed magnetic fields, although current structure remains more dependent on direct magnetic measurements. Full magnetic conditioning also stabilizes completion of missing future density frames. These results demonstrate bidirectional cross-modal predictive coupling within this simulation regime. Generalization across plasma regimes or to experimental measurements remains untested.

arxiv.titleZh: 迈向等离子体状态重建的多模态基础模型

arxiv.title: Exposing AI Inference as a Telco Network API over the 5G User Plane
arxiv.abstract: Supporting edge Artificial Intelligence (AI) inference as a network service is challenging because current mobile systems can transport tensors but do not expose or understand the inference context that gives those tensors operational meaning. Prior studies have addressed this gap through dynamic partitioning, collaborative inference, and split pipelines; however, these solutions remain application-bound, network-blind, or context-free. This work proposes Inference on Demand (IoD), an inference-on-demand abstraction that exposes split inference through a CAMARA-like Application Program Interface (API) and carries a split-aware tensor context in-band across the 5G user plane path. We evaluate the IoD on a programmable user plane function (UPF)-based testbed using a partitionable visual AI workload, showing that adaptive split selection can operate as a network-facing service while avoiding the rigid cost profile of static configurations. Including our findings, split inference becomes more than offloading when the service intent, runtime partitioning, and tensor transport are made visible to the mobile data plane. This opens a path toward network-native AI services, in which programmable telco infrastructure coordinates computation, context, and connectivity for user-facing applications.

arxiv.titleZh: 将 AI 推理作为 5G 用户面上的电信网络 API 暴露

arxiv.title: The Optimal Decoder is Tilted Temperature
arxiv.abstract: Larger sample budgets benefit from higher sampling temperatures in LLMs, but what temperature tuning optimizes and why it works remain poorly understood. We seek to answer these questions: we pose decoding as pass@$k$ maximization subject to two constraints that encode critical decoding failure modes: an entropy floor preventing diversity collapse, and a cross-entropy ceiling preventing implausibility. We prove that this maximization takes the form of a single closed-form conditional sampling rule, the \emph{tilted temperature} $q^\star \propto \bigl(p e^{ηV}\bigr)^{1/T}$. Here, the tilt comes from a verifier potential $V$ that quantifies how likely a partial generation is to eventually pass. Ordinary temperature sampling, verifier-greedy decoding, and reward-tilted policies represent special cases. We further show that, under a natural rule for scaling the diversity budget with sample size $k$, the resulting optimal temperature increases with $k$, turning empirical choice into a theorem. The optimum still needs the unknown verifier potential, which we estimate using two design approaches. In the online setting, our J-EOS algorithm jointly tracks the two constraint multipliers and learns the verifier potential from binary pass/ fail feedback alone. In the offline setting, we show that when the model is calibrated, its log-probability tracks correctness up to an affine map. Under this condition, the tilt collapses into the exponent and the optimum reduces to ordinary temperature sampling. Calibrated Temperature Decoding (CTD) then fits one scalar offline and samples with zero additional inference-time overhead relative to temperature sampling. Building on these decision rules, we design a practical decoding algorithm for code generation and evaluate it alongside CTD on benchmarks including HumanEval and MBPP, showing improvements over standard and adaptive decoding baselines.
arxiv.titleZh: 最优解码器是倾斜温度
arxiv.summaryZh: 把解码温度调参从经验变成理论:以pass@k最大化为目标，加入熵下界防止多样性坍塌、交叉熵上界排除不合理生成，证明最优解码为单一闭式条件采样规则——倾斜温度q*∝(pe^{ηV})^{1/T},V为验证器给出的部分生成最终通过概率，普通温度采样、验证器贪心与奖励倾斜策略都是其特例。在多样性预算随样本数k缩放的规则下，最优温度随k单调上升，把「样本越多温度越高」变成定理。未知的V在在线设定由J-EOS仅凭二元通过/失败反馈估计;离线在模型校准假设下退化为普通温度采样，CTD只需拟合一个标量、推理零额外开销，并在HumanEval、MBPP上超过标准与自适应解码基线。

arxiv.title: Select or Rewrite: Oracle-Guided Fine-Tuning for Generative ASR Post-Editing from N-Best Hypotheses
arxiv.abstract: Large language models can post-edit ASR by using linguistic context to compare N-best hypotheses and rewrite the transcript when needed, often improving WER without retraining the recognizer. However, prompt-only correction is brittle: it may over-edit when top-1 is correct and hallucinate when the reference is absent, and often needs very large models. We propose oracle-guided fine-tuning that turns N-best lists into supervision via three curated pools: corrections (reference in the list but not top-1) to teach selection, regularizers (top-1 correct) to discourage unnecessary rewrites, and hard negatives (reference absent) to suppress hallucination. Fine-tuning on this data provides more effective supervision than random subset fine-tuning for learning a hybrid select-or-rewrite policy, with the clearest gains from around 3B parameters on the proprietary dataset but less conclusive results on CommonVoice, a divergence suggesting that public read-speech text may overlap with LLM pretraining and mask genuine post-editing gains.

arxiv.titleZh: 选择还是重写:基于 N-best 假设的 Oracle 引导微调用于生成式 ASR 后编辑
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 后编辑 ASR 转录时 prompt 方案易过度改写、参考缺失时产生幻觉且依赖超大模型的问题，该工作把 N-best 列表转化为监督信号，构建三个数据池:纠错池(reference 在列表中但非 top-1，教模型选择)、正则池(top-1 正确，抑制无谓改写)与难负例池(reference 缺失，抑制幻觉)，用其微调以学习「选择或重写」的混合策略。结果显示该监督方式优于随机子集微调，在私有数据集上约 3B 参数起增益最明显，但 CommonVoice 上结论不显著，作者推测公开朗读文本与 LLM 预训练数据重叠，掩盖了真实的后编辑收益。

arxiv.title: Trace Evolution Bench: Measuring Whether Agents Improve from Their Own Environment Traces
arxiv.abstract: Self-evolving agents are usually scored by endpoint Gain: held-out success after an update minus success before. That difference can credit a frozen rescore as evolution. We introduce Trace Evolution Bench (TEB), a protocol that separates that rescore from a context or weight update, together with three frozen 80/20/40 packs. An update is accepted only when validation does not fall, held-out identifiers never enter the update, and a text update is not ranked with a weight update. The primary scoreboard is coding, graded by hidden unit tests in a closed workspace. On that pack (40 held-out tasks, one family), DeepSeek v4 Pro under no_evolve never changes its policy yet moves 7.5, 5.0, and 12.5 percentage points across three seeds. Of nine text-update cells inspired by GEPA, ACE, and ExpeL, seven have positive excess above that seed's own band, and one gepa_llm seed moves down by the width of its band (-12.5, regression 0.48). GLM and MiniMax do not reproduce that seven-of-nine pattern. No method stays above its own band on every seed of all three models: GLM has two paired cells above their own bands, and MiniMax expel_llm seed 44 is a third (regression 0.30). The methods were fixed on a validation screen before held-out was read. Office, graded by rule-bounded delivery, and manufacturing table QA are separate packs: office DeepSeek does not exceed its own bands (widest 17.5 points), and manufacturing has no paired positive excess beyond its seed band.
arxiv.titleZh: Trace Evolution Bench:衡量智能体能否从自身环境轨迹中改进
arxiv.summaryZh: 自进化智能体常以更新前后留出集成功率之差计分，该差值会把冻结权重的重打分误记为进化。Trace Evolution Bench(TEB)把重打分与上下文／权重更新分离，要求验证集不下降、留出标识符不进入更新、文本更新不与权重更新混排，并提供 80/20/40 三个冻结任务包，主榜为封闭工作区中按隐藏单测判分的编程任务。在 40 个留出编程任务上，策略不变的 no_evolve 在不同种子间仍波动 7.5、5.0、12.5 个百分点;九个受 GEPA、ACE、ExpeL 启发的文本更新单元中七个超出自身种子波动带，但 GLM 与 MiniMax 无法复现该比例，且无方法在所有种子上都高于自身波动带。
